name: sprite_builder_codespace_read
description: Read a file OR list a directory under the codespace workspace (/workspace/app). Omit path for the workspace root. Returns kind ('file'|'dir'), and either entries[] (dir) or content (file; base64 with binary=true for non-text). Codespace must be 'ready'.

codespace_id.description: The codespace's id (UUID, from sprite_builder_create_codespace / sprite_builder_list_codespaces).

path.description: Path relative to /workspace/app. Omit for the root.
